A personal message from Chris

Hi, there.
I'd like you to meet Rosie AI.

Chris Bongiorno here with Debt Advisors of America.

As a software developer, I'm always looking for new and better ways to connect with my clients and make their experience more personal. That's what inspired me to create Rosie AI—a virtual assistant designed to make it easier to get answers, explore your options, and connect with me when you're ready.

And because I believe everyone should have a choice, I've also created Digital Chris, an AI version of myself. Whether you'd rather speak with Rosie or Digital Chris, the choice is entirely yours.

Both can help explain debt relief options and assist with requesting a personal follow-up. You can always choose to speak with me directly.

Your conversation. Your choice.
